200.body: Sweden plans NATO ground deployments in Finland and Latvia and continued Patriot operations in Poland in 2027 By Martin Chomsky (Defence Industry Europe) NATO | October 19, 2026 Photo: Swedish Armed Forces. 500.title: Deliverance AI and HPE validate agentic AI architecture for enterprise workflows
500.summary: AI Deliverance AI and HPE validate agentic AI architecture for enterprise workflows News Desk 30 minutes ago 0 Deliverance AI and Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) have validated an architecture for deploying AI agents in private-Cloud environments, aiming at organisations that need to automate business processes while retaining control over sensitive data.
500.body: AI Deliverance AI and HPE validate agentic AI architecture for enterprise workflows News Desk 30 minutes ago 0 Deliverance AI and Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) have validated an architecture for deploying AI agents in private-Cloud environments, aiming at organisations that need to automate business processes while retaining control over sensitive data. The solution combines Deliverance Agentic OS with HPE Private Cloud AI, part of the HPE AI Factory with NVIDIA portfolio. The aim is to allow AI agents to handle complex workflows without giving them unrestricted access to enterprise systems or information. Deliverance AI cited results from existing customer deployments: At a global systems integrator , its agents reportedly complete 80% of an initial request for proposal (RFP) response before human review, saving the bid team around 30 hours a week.

600.body: Hungary stuns Poland with last-second touchdown in IFAF European Championship thriller AFI 5 hours ago Hungary pulled off a dramatic 14–10 comeback victory over Poland in the 2026–27 IFAF Men’s European Championship Level 1 competition, scoring the winning touchdown with just seven seconds remaining at Budapest Rugby Center before more than 2,000 spectators.
